The TRCA watercourse layer is a line feature layer representing the approximate centerline of the river channel. It is maintained by desktop interpretation using current orthophotography as the base source. The update of this version is based on consultation with TRCA development, infrastructure and technical review staff, municipalities, the development industry, and the public. The update used 2015 Lidar DEM and 2018 ortho photo.

TRCA's current watercourse layer is part of TRCA's Water Resource System: TRCA Water Resource System | TRCA Open Data Portal (arcgis.com)

If looking for the most up to date data, pleaser refer to 'WRS Permanent & Intermittent Streams' in the TRCA Water Resource System.
